job.title: Onsite Operations Account Manager
job.description:
As an Onsite Operations/Account Manager, you will have direct ownership and control of all client relations, recruiting and operations functions for client sites that operate in a 24/7 model.

You’ll manage the local relationship with our distribution center client and internal staffing teams.

You’ll foster close relationships with centralized business support units. To be successful in this role you’ll need to be data driven with strong customer focus and experience with workforce teams of 100+ hourly staff

For consideration we require fluency in Spanish/English (reading/writing/speaking) 

What you'll do: 
  • Manage our client relationship for contingent workers at their warehouse location
  • Support the onboarding, safety, productivity, quality, hires, terminations, performance management of our contingent workers
  • Full ownership of recruiting, onsite, candidate, and associate programs and initiatives 
  • Track and maintain the performance and effectiveness of your sites via established KPI’s and daily, weekly and monthly reports. Identify areas of opportunity for continuous improvement to established KPI’s.
  • Create, review, and provide critical analysis of recruiting activity for the market, devise action plans for continuous improvement.
  • Monitor, report and conduct business reviews with clients to improve performance, identify areas to be stronger partners, and enhance our overall partnership.
  • Hire, train, manage, and motivate a team of client-facing hourly staff  supporting client needs for both recruiting and client onsite roles in multiple locations.
  • Provide ongoing feedback and development plans for staff to support their success. Partner with HR to complete employee evaluations and to issue disciplinary action, when needed, up to and including termination 
  • Obey all the safety and workplace policies of our client while on their premises.
 
What you'll need:
  • Minimum of 4-years of progressive experience in leadership roles with P & L responsibilities, in a warehouse, e-commerce, manufacturing environment with client facing responsibilities of 100+
  • Experience with contingent workforce/staffing industry is highly desired
  • Fluent in Spanish/English (reading/writing/speaking) is helpful but not required
  • Experience managing an hourly workforce in retail or warehouse space
  • Ability to speak to Client regarding temporary workforce performance metrics, recruiting, safety & employee relations
  • Experience with Bullhorn strongly preferred
  • Exceptional time management skills such as prioritizing/organizing and tracking details and meeting deadlines of multiple projects with varying completion dates
  • Strong process focus shown in examples of creating and driving strategies that include visual controls, standard accountability process and  lead standard work.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills
  • Travel may be 25% + based upon business needs  
  • Adhere to all client and ISS business ethics codes
Pay Rage: $55,000-75,000

Physical Demands: At times, you may be rolling up your sleeves and fulfilling orders for our customer experience driven clients. This may require that you perform anything from working in facility process paths, walking continuously and lifting, carrying, climbing steps, pushing, pulling materials or products.

job.title: Gear Manufacturing Lead
job.description:
Gear Manufacturing Lead

Location: Suwanee, GA
Job Type: Full-Time
Industry: Manufacturing / Precision Machining
Shift: 7am - 3:30pm
Days: Mon -  Fri

Position Summary

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking an experienced Gear Manufacturing Lead for a manufacturing operation in Suwanee, GA.

This is a hands-on leadership position for someone who combines strong gear manufacturing and machining knowledge with the ability to lead, coach, and develop production employees.

The Manufacturing Lead will help coordinate daily production activities, provide technical support on the floor, maintain safety and quality expectations, troubleshoot manufacturing issues, and ensure the team achieves production goals.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Performance

  • Provide day-to-day leadership and direction to manufacturing employees.

  • Assign work and coordinate workflow based on production schedules, priorities, equipment availability, and staffing.

  • Communicate daily production goals, quality expectations, and safety requirements.

  • Monitor employee performance and provide real-time coaching and feedback.

  • Train and develop new and existing employees on manufacturing processes, equipment, quality standards, and safe work practices.

  • Identify opportunities for employee cross-training and skill development.

  • Promote teamwork, accountability, urgency, and continuous improvement.

  • Conduct or participate in shift-start meetings and effective shift handoffs.

  • Escalate production, quality, safety, equipment, and employee concerns appropriately.

  • Lead by example in attendance, dependability, productivity, safety, quality, and workplace conduct.

Gear Manufacturing & Technical Responsibilities

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership within gear manufacturing and precision machining operations.

  • Apply working knowledge of gear cutting, machining, and gear-finishing processes.

  • Support CNC machining and gear manufacturing operations while ensuring established specifications and process parameters are followed.

  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, manufacturing specifications, and tolerances.

  • Understand gear terminology, dimensions, tolerances, tooth geometry, and critical quality characteristics.

  • Assist operators with machine setup, tooling, offsets, changeovers, and troubleshooting as appropriate.

  • Monitor machining processes and finished components to identify potential quality or process issues.

  • Use and understand precision measuring and inspection equipment such as micrometers, calipers, indicators, and gauges.

  • Troubleshoot issues involving tooling, equipment, materials, processes, dimensions, and finished-part quality.

  • Identify root causes of production problems and participate in corrective actions.

  • Monitor tooling and equipment conditions and communicate concerns before they result in significant downtime.

  • Support continuous-improvement efforts focused on increasing throughput, reducing setup time, minimizing scrap and rework, and improving overall efficiency.

Safety & Quality

  • Maintain a strong safety-first culture and ensure team members follow established safety procedures and PPE requirements.

  • Address unsafe behaviors or conditions immediately.

  • Ensure employees follow standard work, manufacturing procedures, inspection requirements, and quality specifications.

  • Promote quality at the source by identifying problems before components move to subsequent operations.

  • Assist with investigations involving defects, scrap, rework, equipment issues, and process deviations.

  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas.

Performance Expectations

The Manufacturing Lead will help drive measurable improvement in:

  • Safety performance

  • Production schedule attainment

  • Daily output and throughput

  • First-pass quality/yield

  • Scrap and rework

  • Equipment uptime

  • Setup and changeover efficiency

  • Employee productivity

  • Attendance and schedule adherence

  • Training and cross-training

  • Continuous improvement

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of manufacturing experience, preferably involving gear manufacturing, precision machining, transmission/drivetrain components, or related metal manufacturing.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of gear manufacturing and machining processes.

  • Experience with CNC machining and/or gear cutting equipment.

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, tolerances, and manufacturing specifications.

  • Working knowledge of precision measuring tools and inspection techniques.

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting ability.

  • Ability to identify machining, tooling, dimensional, and quality problems.

  • Ability to train, coach, and provide direction to production employees.

  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to prioritize multiple production requirements in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a Team Lead, Manufacturing Lead, Senior Operator, Setup Technician, or similar production leadership role.

  • Direct experience manufacturing gears, transmissions, or drivetrain components.

  • Experience with gear hobbing, shaping, cutting, grinding, or related gear-finishing processes.

  • CNC machine setup and operation experience.

  • Experience with precision inspection and metrology equipment.

  • Lean manufacturing, 5S, root-cause analysis, or continuous-improvement experience.

  • Previous responsibility for production KPIs, employee training, or shift performance.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who can do more than supervise a shift. The right candidate will understand the manufacturing process, recognize problems on the floor, help employees solve them, and hold the team accountable for results.

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

  • Leadership: Set clear expectations and lead by example.

  • Accountability: Take ownership of safety, quality, productivity, and team performance.

  • Technical Knowledge: Understand gear manufacturing well enough to coach employees and troubleshoot production issues.

  • Problem Solving: Identify issues early and help determine practical solutions.

  • Employee Development: Build the skills and capabilities of the team.

  • Continuous Improvement: Look for ways to make operations safer, more efficient, and more productive.

  • Communication: Effectively communicate priorities, problems, and results between employees and management.

Apply Today

If you have hands-on gear manufacturing experience and are ready to take the next step into a leadership role, Integrity Staffing Solutions wants to hear from you.

Apply today to learn more about this opportunity in Suwanee, GA.

We’re looking for a Package Handler to join a dynamic, growing operation in Bethel, PA in a brand new warehouse facility. This is a temp-to-hire opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced warehouse environment, stays safety-focused, and takes pride in helping a team hit daily production goals. Candidates must read, write, and speak English fluently.

job.title: Onsite Warehouse Account Manager
job.description:
As an Onsite Operations/Account Manager, you will have direct ownership and control of all client relations, recruiting and operations functions for client sites that operate in a 24/7 model.

You’ll manage the local relationship with our distribution center client and internal staffing teams.

You’ll foster close relationships with centralized business support units. To be successful in this role you’ll need to be data driven with strong customer focus and experience with workforce teams of 100+ hourly staff

For consideration we require fluency in Spanish/English (reading/writing/speaking) 

What you'll do: 
  • Manage our client relationship for contingent workers at their warehouse location
  • Support the onboarding, safety, productivity, quality, hires, terminations, performance management of our contingent workers
  • Full ownership of recruiting, onsite, candidate, and associate programs and initiatives 
  • Track and maintain the performance and effectiveness of your sites via established KPI’s and daily, weekly and monthly reports. Identify areas of opportunity for continuous improvement to established KPI’s.
  • Create, review, and provide critical analysis of recruiting activity for the market, devise action plans for continuous improvement.
  • Monitor, report and conduct business reviews with clients to improve performance, identify areas to be stronger partners, and enhance our overall partnership.
  • Hire, train, manage, and motivate a team of client-facing hourly staff  supporting client needs for both recruiting and client onsite roles in multiple locations.
  • Provide ongoing feedback and development plans for staff to support their success. Partner with HR to complete employee evaluations and to issue disciplinary action, when needed, up to and including termination 
  • Obey all the safety and workplace policies of our client while on their premises.
 
What you'll need:
  • Minimum of 4-years of progressive experience in leadership roles with P & L responsibilities, in a warehouse, e-commerce, manufacturing environment with client facing responsibilities of 100+
  • Experience with contingent workforce/staffing industry is highly desired
  • Fluent in Spanish/English (reading/writing/speaking) is helpful but not required
  • Experience managing an hourly workforce in retail or warehouse space
  • Ability to speak to Client regarding temporary workforce performance metrics, recruiting, safety & employee relations
  • Experience with Bullhorn strongly preferred
  • Exceptional time management skills such as prioritizing/organizing and tracking details and meeting deadlines of multiple projects with varying completion dates
  • Strong process focus shown in examples of creating and driving strategies that include visual controls, standard accountability process and  lead standard work.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills
  • Travel may be 25% + based upon business needs  
  • Adhere to all client and ISS business ethics codes
Pay Rage: $55,000-65,000

Physical Demands: At times, you may be rolling up your sleeves and fulfilling orders for our customer experience driven clients. This may require that you perform anything from working in facility process paths, walking continuously and lifting, carrying, climbing steps, pushing, pulling materials or products.

  • Stable and consistent schedule
  • Work in a dynamic team-focused environment

As a Warehouse Associate, you'll be manually loading and unloading freight, sorting, stacking, and securing items onto pallets, assisting with basic assembly tasks, and moving inventory throughout the facility using manual or electric pallet jacks. You’ll also be responsible for maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment.

job.title: Warehouse Yard Jockey
job.description:
Job Summary

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking a safety-focused and dependable Yard Jockey to support daily warehouse and transportation operations within a private, self-contained facility yard. The Yard Jockey is responsible for the safe and efficient movement of trailers, yard equipment, and company assets between dock doors, staging areas, and assigned yard locations.

Pay and Shift: 
$26 per hour
Sun-Wed - 11am-9:30pm
Wed-Sat - 11am-9:30pm

This position operates exclusively on private facility property. There is no public roadway, highway, over-the-road, or overnight driving required.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Yard & Trailer Operations

  • Safely move trailers and company equipment throughout the facility yard as directed by Operations, Transportation, and Warehouse leadership

  • Spot trailers accurately at dock doors, staging areas, and designated yard locations

  • Pull trailers from dock doors only after confirming all required safety and release procedures have been completed

  • Stage trailers to dock doors in alignment with operational needs and dock assignments

  • Maintain constant awareness of yard traffic, pedestrians, dock activity, and equipment movement

  • Operate yard truck/yard goat/hostler/yard tractor in accordance with company safety standards

  • Follow all trailer docking and releasing procedures, including required Trailer Dock Release coordination

  • Maintain safe speeds, use horn signals as required, and stop for pedestrians or unsafe yard conditions

Equipment Inspections & Safety

  • Complete pre-shift inspections of the yard truck prior to beginning trailer moves

  • Inspect key equipment components (brakes, steering, tires, lights, mirrors, horn, backup alarm, fifth wheel, air lines, electrical connections, and fuel/charge level)

  • Perform visual trailer inspections before coupling (landing gear, tires, rear doors, trailer frame, undercarriage, and visible damage)

  • Confirm trailers are safe to move before coupling or relocating

  • Perform proper coupling/uncoupling procedures (fifth wheel lock confirmation, air line + electrical connection, landing gear operation, tug test)

  • Report unsafe equipment, trailer damage, defects, near-misses, incidents, or yard hazards immediately

  • Remove unsafe equipment from operation when required and notify the appropriate supervisor/manager

Communication & Coordination

  • Communicate clearly with Dock Clerks, Dock Supervisors, Transportation, Warehouse, and Operations teams

  • Confirm trailer number, origin, and destination prior to each move

  • Notify the appropriate team member when each move is complete

  • Escalate blocked doors, damaged trailers, unclear instructions, equipment issues, or safety concerns before proceeding

  • Use a two-way radio throughout the shift and maintain professional radio communication

  • Serve as a key liaison between Transportation and Warehouse teams to support trailer flow, dock availability, and operational priorities

Compliance & Yard Safety

  • Follow all company yard safety policies, OSHA-aligned safety practices, and site-specific procedures

  • Wear required PPE (high-visibility safety vest and safety-toe footwear)

  • Carry and monitor an active, charged radio while working in the yard

  • Yield to pedestrians at all times and maintain safe separation from people, vehicles, trailers, dock doors, and fixed structures

  • Use a ground guide when required or when visibility is obstructed

  • Stop work and notify management immediately in the event of an incident, near-miss, collision, equipment damage, or unsafe condition

What You’ll Need (Required Qualifications)

  • Valid Class A Commercial Driver’s License (CDL A)

  • Active/current DOT Medical Examiner’s Certificate (Medical Card)

  • Prior experience operating commercial vehicles, yard trucks, yard goats, hostlers, or similar equipment

  • Ability to safely couple, move, spot, and uncouple trailers in a yard/warehouse environment

  • Ability to complete required Trailer Docking and Releasing Safety Program upon hire

  • Forklift certification or ability to obtain certification on Pacer and Electric Pallet Jack equipment (including single/double pallet jack operation)

  • Strong understanding of yard safety, trailer movement, backing procedures, dock operations, and equipment inspections

  • Ability to communicate clearly over radio and follow verbal instructions accurately

  • Must be dependable, safety-conscious, detail-oriented, and able to work in a fast-paced logistics environment

Nice to Have (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Previous yard jockey/hostler/spotter/CDL driver experience, dock operations, warehouse, logistics, transportation, or trailer spotting experience

  • Completion of an accredited CDL truck driving program

  • Vocational training/coursework in logistics, transportation, heavy equipment operations, supply chain, or related field

  • Experience in fulfillment, distribution, transportation, or warehouse operations

  • Familiarity with trailer docking, trailer release procedures, dock safety, and yard management practices

Physical & Work Environment

  • Ability to work in an active outdoor yard and warehouse environment

  • Ability to climb in/out of yard trucks and trailers as needed

  • Ability to walk the yard, inspect equipment, connect/disconnect air lines and electrical cords, and operate landing gear

  • Ability to work in varying weather and lighting conditions (rain, heat, cold, low-light operations)

  • Ability to wear required PPE for the duration of the shift

  • Ability to remain alert and focused while operating equipment around pedestrians, dock doors, trailers, and moving vehicles

Why Work With Integrity Staffing Solutions

At Integrity Staffing Solutions, we put people first. We help associates find the right opportunity, succeed on the job, and grow their careers—backed by a team that supports you every step of the way.

Benefits

Eligible associates may have access to benefits such as:

  • Medical, dental, and vision options

  • Paid time off and holiday pay (where applicable)

  • Career advancement and training opportunities

  • Referral programs (where available)

(If you have a standard “day-one benefits” paragraph you prefer, paste it and I’ll swap it in.)

Pre-Employment / Work Authorization (Standard Evergreen Language)

  • Candidates must be able to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States.

  • This role may require successful completion of worksite-specific screening, which can include background check and/or drug screening based on client or site requirements.

AI-Assisted Hiring Notice (Requested)

Integrity Staffing Solutions may use AI-assisted tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as helping review application information, evaluating job-related skills, and improving recruiting efficiency. These tools are used to support—not replace—human decision-making. All final hiring decisions are made by our recruiting and hiring teams.

job.title: HR Coordinator Bilingual
job.description:
HR  Coordinator – Temp role with no end date

Pay rate: $22 per hour 
Shift: Mon-Fri 8am-5pm OT as needed based on business need
Language: Must be fluent in Spanish & English
Location: Phillipsburg, NJ

Benefits & Perks:

  • Weekly paychecks
  • Opportunity to earn OT
  • Benefits from day one - Medical, dental and vision, including Telemedicine 
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program
  • Career growth opportunities and skill development

As an HR Coordinator, you will focus on employee relations, investigations, taking statements, documentation, and communication with remote HR leadership, while also providing day-to-day support for onsite operations.


Based full-time at the customer warehouse, you will serve as a primary point of contact for associates and client managers, balancing HR responsibilities with operational coordination to maintain a positive associate and client experience.  This is not a remote position.


What You’ll Do
  • Act as the onsite HR liaison, representing Integrity Staffing and serving as the link between associates, client managers, and the remote HR leader.
  • Conduct and support employee relations investigations, including interviewing associates, taking statements, documenting incidents, and escalating findings to the remote HR leader for review.
  • Handle confidential associate concerns related to conduct, performance, policy compliance, and workplace interactions.
  • Support onboarding and orientation activities, ensuring associates understand workplace expectations, attendance policies, and escalation procedures.
  • Monitor attendance, validate absences, and maintain documentation for HR-related case tracking.
  • Assist with corrective action processes by preparing documentation, scheduling follow-ups, and ensuring consistency in handling cases.
  • Communicate regularly with the remote HR leader on escalated matters, sharing detailed documentation and recommendations.
What You’ll Need
  • 2–3 years of HR, employee relations, or operations coordination experience; warehouse environment is required
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English (reading/writing/speaking)
  • Demonstrated experience with investigations, interviewing, and incident documentation.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple sensitive issues simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook and Office Suite; ability to adapt to client-specific HR/operations systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to confidently interact with associates, client managers, and HR leadership.
  • High level of discretion, confidentiality, and sound judgment in handling sensitive HR matters.
  • Flexibility to work in a fast-paced environment with both desk-based and floor-based responsibilities.
 

Physical Demands
This role is based on the floor in the warehouse and requires regular walking and standing, climbing steps, and occasional lifting (up to 49 lbs.) or movement of materials.

job.title: Maintenance Team Lead Technician 2nd Shift
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Maintenance Team Lead to join our Reliability Department. This key role is responsible for leading a team of maintenance technicians and ensuring our production equipment and facilities operate safely and efficiently.

Ready to lead and make a real impact? Apply today to join a team where your skills and leadership will be valued!

Pay: $36 – $38 per hour
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM

Snapshot of a Day-in-the-Life:

  • Lead, direct, and support maintenance team members during the afternoon shift.
  • Coordinate and assign preventative maintenance, scheduled repairs, and emergency response.
  • Train, mentor, and onboard new maintenance personnel.
  • Troubleshoot equipment issues and ensure timely, effective resolutions.
  • Maintain compliance with HAACP, SQF, and GMP standards.
  • Inspect facility and equipment for proper function and safety compliance.
  • Assist with inventory management and upkeep of tools and equipment.
  • Complete and submit accurate documentation and maintenance logs.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours support.

What You’ll Bring:

  • High school diploma (or equivalent) required, associate’s degree from a technical school preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years of mechanical experience in a manufacturing setting; 5+ years preferred.
  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage team dynamics effectively.
  • Strong knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems, including pneumatics, hydraulics, PLCs, VFDs, and control safety circuits.
  • Experience with welding, machining, fabrication, HVAC, boilers, and ammonia systems is a plus.
  • Familiarity with OSHA safety standards and arc flash regulations.
  • Proficient in troubleshooting and problem-solving.
  • Comfortable lifting up to 50 lbs. and working independently or within a team.
  • Experience with SAP or similar CMMS software is advantageous.

job.title: Call center
job.description:
Collections Representative

Location: Newark, Delaware | 100% On-Site
Pay: $16.00 per hour
Schedule: Full-Time, Flexible Day/Evening Availability Required
Training: Paid, Monday-Friday, 8:30 AM-4:30 PM

Position Overview

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking Collections Representatives for an established financial services and accounts receivable organization in Newark, Delaware.

This is an excellent opportunity for customer service professionals interested in transitioning into the collections industry. Previous collections experience is preferred but not required. Comprehensive training is provided to help you develop the skills needed to succeed.

As a Collections Representative, you will communicate with consumers by phone, provide professional customer service, discuss account and payment matters, and work toward appropriate resolutions. Successful candidates will be comfortable having financial conversations while remaining professional, respectful, and attentive to established procedures.

What You'll Do

  • Communicate professionally with consumers regarding their accounts.

  • Provide a positive customer experience while handling potentially sensitive financial conversations.

  • Work with consumers to understand their circumstances and identify appropriate account resolutions.

  • Accurately document conversations, account information, and outcomes.

  • Follow established policies, procedures, scripts, and compliance requirements.

  • Handle inbound and outbound telephone communication professionally.

  • Meet established performance, quality, attendance, and productivity expectations.

  • Participate fully in training and ongoing coaching.

  • Maintain professionalism and confidentiality when handling consumer information.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Previous customer service experience.

  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.

  • Professional and respectful telephone presence.

  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused during challenging conversations.

  • Comfortable discussing account and payment-related matters.

  • Basic computer skills and ability to learn new systems.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established procedures.

  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.

  • Ability to work 100% on-site in Newark, DE.

  • Ability to meet all scheduling requirements.

Preferred:

  • Previous collections or accounts receivable experience.

job.title: Director Human Resources, Fulfillment Operations
job.description:
Senior Director of Human Resources – Fulfillment Operations

 

Location: Dallas, Atlanta, Los Angeles, Chicago or Bellevue, WA

Travel: Approximately 50%

 

Our client is seeking an experienced HR leader to build and scale the HR function across a growing, multi-state fulfillment network.

 

This highly visible role will partner with Operations leadership to transition a contingent workforce to a full-time employee model while strengthening compliance, employee relations, talent acquisition, and workforce planning.

 

 

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive HR strategy for fulfillment operations that aligns with organizational objectives, growth plans, and operational priorities.
  • Lead the strategic transition from a temporary or contingent workforce to a full-time employee model across multiple fulfillment centers.
  • Develop the policies, procedures, staffing plans, onboarding programs, compensation practices, and employee-integration processes required to support the workforce transition.
  • Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing HR team supporting geographically dispersed fulfillment centers.
  • Establish scalable HR operating procedures, service-delivery standards, reporting practices, and accountability measures.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to senior Operations leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, talent management, retention, productivity, and employee engagement.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws across a complex, multi-state operating environment.
  • Develop workforce plans that support seasonal demands, facility growth, hiring forecasts, turnover reduction, and labor-cost objectives.
  • Lead high-volume talent-acquisition strategies for hourly, non-exempt, professional, and leadership positions.
  • Design and implement performance-management, succession-planning, leadership-development, and employee-retention programs.
  • Establish meaningful HR metrics and reporting related to headcount, turnover, absenteeism, time to fill, employee relations, labor costs, and compliance.
  • Champion a high-performance culture centered on accountability, operational excellence, employee engagement, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain a strong on-site presence throughout the fulfillment network and travel approximately 50% to support facilities, leaders, and employees.

 

 

What You’ll Bring

  • 12+ years of progressive HR experience, including 5+ years in HR leadership
  • HR leadership experience within multi-site fulfillment, logistics, distribution, manufacturing, or warehouse operations
  • Proven experience supporting large hourly and non-exempt workforces across multiple locations
  • Experience in a heavily regulated logistics, transportation, fulfillment, manufacturing, or supply-chain organization.
  • Demonstrated success building or scaling HR capabilities in a growing organization
  • Experience transitioning contingent or temporary employees to full-time roles
  • Strong knowledge of employment law, employee relations, investigations, claims management, and multi-state compliance
  • Experience supporting operations in NJ, WI, TX, GA, and CA
  • Expertise in high-volume hiring, workforce planning, retention, and HR metrics
  • Ability to travel approximately 50%
  • Must be based in or near Dallas, Atlanta, Los Angeles, or Bellevue
  • A bachelor’s degree and SPHR or SHRM-SCP certification

job.description:
Executive Administrative Assistant

Our client is a family-owned printing business seeking a dependable, highly organized Executive Administrative Assistant to support management and help keep daily office operations running smoothly. 

This is a hands-on position requiring professionalism, accuracy, strong follow-through, and excellent communication skills.

 

This is a full-time, in-person position directly with our client. Remote work is not available.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Answer and direct incoming phone calls and emails
  • Prepare and send professional correspondence, documents, and reports
  • Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems
  • Assist with preparing quotes, invoices, purchase orders, and other business documents
  • Enter and maintain accurate information in spreadsheets and company systems
  • Communicate and follow up with customers, vendors, and other business contacts
  • Track open projects, customer orders, and pending items to help ensure timely completion
  • Schedule appointments, meetings, deliveries, and other business activities
  • Review documents and information for accuracy and completeness
  • Assist with billing, recordkeeping, filing, and general office paperwork
  • Coordinate information among management, employees, customers, and vendors
  • Maintain confidential company, employee, and customer information
  • Assist management with daily administrative needs and special projects
  • Monitor deadlines and follow up with the appropriate individuals when action is required
  • Maintain an organized, professional, and efficient office environment

 

Qualifications

  • Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Office Coordinator, or in a similar administrative role
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organizational, time-management, and follow-up abilities
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Professional and courteous when communicating with customers, vendors, employees, and management

  • Comfortable learning company software and business systems
  • Ability to prioritize multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a close-knit team
  • Sound judgment and the ability to handle confidential information appropriately
  • Experience with quotes, invoices, purchase orders, billing, or order tracking is preferred
  • Printing, manufacturing, distribution, or related industry experience is helpful but not required

job.description:
Job Title: Customer Support Associate – Warehouse
Worksite: Flexport Pleasant Prairie
Location: 9091 88th Ave Pleasant Prairie Wisconsin 53158
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–3:30 PM (flexibility for overtime/weekends/holidays may be needed based on business demand)
Pay: $25.00
Type: Full-time

Overview

Integrity Staffing Solutions is hiring Customer Support Associates to support operations at Flexport’s Pleasant Prairie warehouse. This is an on-site role that blends customer support with hands-on warehouse collaboration. You’ll be the frontline advocate for service quality—resolving issues in real time, escalating when needed, and helping ensure a smooth shipment lifecycle from inbound to outbound.

What You’ll Do

Customer Support

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer questions and issues (phone/email/chat as needed).
  • Resolve inquiries quickly and professionally while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Follow established SOPs and document/escalate issues appropriately.
  • Adapt to new tools/technology and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Warehouse Operations Support (On-site)

  • Partner with warehouse teams to understand fulfillment workflows and support problem-solving on the floor.
  • Participate in varied warehouse functions to build working knowledge of processes.
  • Help educate associates on support systems and best practices for issue resolution.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Support service-level expectations (SLA) by prioritizing and closing issues efficiently.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma/GED required

  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving, prioritization, and empathy
  • Comfortable working in a team-oriented, changing environment

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

job.title: Water Utility Operations Supervisor
job.description:
Supervisor – Water Transmission & Distribution

Want to lead from the field instead of spending every day behind a desk?

We’re looking for a hands-on leader who enjoys construction, daily field activity, and solving problems as they arise. In this role, you’ll supervise water transmission and distribution crews, coordinate construction and repair projects, and help keep critical utility infrastructure operating safely and reliably.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with water distribution and construction management experience who wants meaningful leadership responsibility, room to grow, excellent benefits, and the ability to be home every night.
 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and coordinate the daily activities of transmission and distribution field crews.
  • Plan and oversee the construction, installation, maintenance, and repair of water mains, pipelines, valves, hydrants, and service connections.
  • Spend time in the field inspecting work, resolving challenges, and ensuring projects meet safety, quality, and regulatory standards.
  • Apply creative problem-solving to leaks, breaks, outages, construction issues, and other service disruptions.
  • Coordinate priorities with operations, dispatch, engineering, customer service, contractors, and vendors.
  • Coach, train, and develop crew leaders and utility employees.
  • Support employee evaluations, performance management, and accountability.
  • Assist with infrastructure upgrades, capital projects, and construction planning.
  • Monitor vehicles, equipment, pre-trip inspections, DOT requirements, materials, and inventory.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance, repair, project, and operational records.
  • Support emergency-response coordination and on-call field crews as needed.
  • Communicate daily work activity and project updates across departments.
 

What We’re Looking For

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • At least five years of field experience installing, repairing, and maintaining water distribution systems.
  • At least three years of supervisory experience leading, training, and developing employees.
  • Construction management or project management experience strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of underground piping, utility maps, installation practices, and field safety.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to develop practical solutions in changing field conditions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Intermediate computer skills and the ability to learn company-specific systems.
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • A field-focused leadership role with visible, meaningful results.
  • Challenging construction and infrastructure projects.
  • The freedom to solve problems and make an impact.
  • The opportunity to lead and develop an experienced team.
  • Career advancement and room to grow.
  • Excellent benefits.
  • Local work that allows you to be home each night.
 

Work Environment

This position combines outdoor field leadership with some office responsibilities. The work involves construction sites, heavy equipment, underground utilities, changing weather conditions, climbing, bending, and lifting. Participation in emergency response and occasional after-hours callouts is required.

job.title: Civil Engineer
job.description:
Tired of tracking billable hours and wondering where your next project is coming from?

Join our client’s internal engineering team and focus on what you do best—delivering major water and wastewater infrastructure projects. As part of an in-house service division, you’ll have the time and resources to do the work properly, without billable-hour pressure or the constant demands of consulting.

 

You’ll work on meaningful, large-scale projects throughout the Delmarva area while enjoying project stability, an excellent benefits package, and a healthier work-life balance.

If you’re a civil or environmental engineer ready to leave consulting behind - let's talk today!

 

 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborates with Senior Engineers and other staff in the design, analysis, and evaluation of engineering systems, components, and processes using applicable engineering software, calculations, modeling, and simulations.
  • Independently develops engineering design plans, specifications, reports, and technical documentation for water and wastewater projects as part of a project team.
  • Collects, processes, and analyzes data; evaluates alternative solutions; and prepares technical reports and design documents to support engineering recommendations and conclusions.
  • Prepares and maintains accurate engineering drawings, specifications, reports, calculations, and other project documentation in accordance with project requirements and regulatory standards.
  • Assists with project planning, budgets, schedules, resource forecasting, cost tracking, and project closeout activities.
  • Identifies and troubleshoots technical issues and collaborates with project teams to develop effective solutions within established project requirements, budgets, and schedules.
  • Coordinates construction project submittals, deliverables, reviews, and approvals to ensure compliance with contract requirements.
  • Coordinates with GIS and Survey departments to obtain topographic, location, boundary, record plan, and other information necessary for project planning, design, and permitting.
  • Requests, reviews, and evaluates proposals from consultants and contractors.
  • Reviews development plans submitted by outside consultants and engineers and checks engineering design calculations for compliance with company standards and specifications.
  • Researches engineering topics, regulations, technologies, and industry practices and prepares reports or presentations to communicate findings.

 

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or the ability to acquire one within 2 years required.
  • A valid driver's license with clean driving record in accordance with company and insurance standards
  • Minimum of five (5) years of professional engineering experience as a licensed Professional Engineer.
  • Proficiency with personal computers and applicable engineering software.
  • Ability to independently analyze complex engineering problems, exercise sound judgment, and develop effective technical solutions.
  • Ability to collect, interpret, and analyze technical data and reach sound conclusions in a timely manner.
  • Knowledge of applicable federal, state, and local regulations and engineering standards.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical information to employees, departments, consultants, contractors, and regulatory agencies.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with water and wastewater infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with engineering design, construction management, project coordination, permitting, and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience with GIS, surveying data, engineering modeling, and design software.
  • Experience reviewing consultant and contractor proposals, plans, specifications, and technical submittals.

job.description:

Our client is hiring a highly experienced IT Infrastructure professional to manage and support our Windows, Linux, Active Directory, virtualization, Microsoft 365, and cloud environments. job.title: Amazon Sortation Center Warehouse Associate
job.description:
Amazon Sortation Center Warehouse Associate

Location:
Plainfield, IN
Job opportunities vary by location. We update postings daily with open positions.

Hourly pay rate: Up to $21.75
 
Job Overview
You’ll be part of the dedicated Amazon team that is the first stop on the journey from the warehouse. Our fast-paced, physical roles take place in a sortation center. You will be sorting, scanning, and stacking packages on pallets, helping to get customer orders ready for delivery. Because most of the shifts are part-time, you are in control of your schedule choosing shifts that work best for you now and the ability to adjust your schedule in the future, as needed.

Duties & Responsibilities
Some of your duties may include:
  1. Receive and sort inventory
  2. Get customer orders ready for delivery
  3. Use technology like scanners, computers, and handheld printers
You'll also need to be able to:
  1. Lift up to 49 pounds
  2. Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  3. Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  4. Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  5. Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)

What it’s like at an Amazon Sortation Center
  1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide protective gear. All teams share safety tips daily.
  2. Surroundings. You’ll be working around moving machines – order pickers, stand-up forklifts, turret trucks, and mobile carts.
  3. Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
  4. Temperature. Even with climate controls, temperatures can vary between 60°F and 90°F in some parts of the warehouse; on hot days, temperatures can be over 90°F in the truck yard or inside trailers.
  5. Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  6. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes are required. Depending on the role or location, Amazon provides a $110 Zappos gift code towards the purchase of shoes, in order to have you prepared for your first day on the job.

Why You'll Love this Job
  1. Stay busy. You and your team are engaged the entire shift.
  2. Schedule options. Depending on where you work, schedules may include full-time (40 hours), reduced-time (30-36 hours) or part-time (20 hours or less), all with the option of working additional hours if needed.
  3. Shift flexibility. Work when it works for you. Shifts may include overnight, early morning, day, evening, and weekend. You can even have four-day workweeks, three-day weekends – and with Anytime Shifts, you can work as little as four hours per week.
  4. Anytime Pay. You can instantly cash out up to 70% of your earnings immediately after your shift (for select employee groups). Learn more about Anytime Pay..
  5. Career advancement. We have made a pledge to upskill our employees and offer a variety of free training and development programs, and we also have tuition support options for select employee groups. See where your Amazon journey can take you.
  6. New skills. Depending on the role and location, you’ll learn how to use the latest Amazon technology – including handheld devices and robotics.
  7. Team environment. Work on small or large teams that support each other.

Why You'll Love Amazon
Many of our jobs come with great benefits – including healthcare, parental leave, ways to save for the future, and opportunities for career advancement – all in a safe and inclusive environment that’s been ranked among the best workplaces in the world. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location, and can include the following:
  1. Competitive wage paid weekly, with overtime for more than 40 hours
  2. Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  3. Medical Advice Line
  4. Network of Support (health & well-being on and off the job)
  5. Adoption Assistance
  6. Maternity and Parental Leave
  7. 401(k) savings plan
  8. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  9. Holiday pay opportunities
  10. Employee discounts
  11. Basic life insurance
  12. AD&D insurance
  13. Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  14. On-the-job training and skills development
  15. Employee Assistance Program
 
Learn more about Amazon Benefits and Culture
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits#/
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/culture#/

Requirements:
  1. Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirement and safety guidelines

How To Get Started
You can begin by applying above. If you need help with your application or to learn more about our hiring process, you can find support here: https://hiring.amazon.com/hiring-process#/.

If you have a disability and need an accommodation during the application and hiring process, including support for the New Hire Event, or need to initiate a request prior to starting your Day 1, please visit https://hiring.amazon.com/people-with-disabilities#/ or contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT). You can reach us by phone at 888-435-9287, Monday through Friday, between 6 a.m. and 4 p.m. PT.

job.title: Amazon Warehouse Equipment Operator
job.description:
Amazon Warehouse Equipment Operator

Location:
Plainfield, IN
Job opportunities vary by location. We update postings daily with open positions.

Hourly pay rate: Up to $21.75/hr

Job OverviewYou'll be part of the Amazon warehouse team as an equipment operator - operating order pickers, reach trucks, forklifts, and other powered industrial trucks (PIT) to handle customer orders safely and efficiently. You'll use PIT equipment to unload and load trailers, store pallets, and retrieve pallets throughout the warehouse. No prior experience required—Amazon provides all PIT training and certification for free.

Duties & Responsibilities
Some of your duties may include:
  1. Receive and put away inventory
  2. Get customer orders ready and pack them up
  3. Load boxes into trucks for shipment
  4. Use scanners to read bar codes on products
  5. View prompts on screens and follow the direction for some tasks
  6. Troubleshoot problems
  7. Ensure product meets quality requirements
  8. Operate power industrial trucks (PIT) such as a forklift or pallet driver, and work at heights up to 35 feet. Equipment training and certification are provided free of cost.
You'll also need to be able to:
  1. Lift up to 49 pounds
  2. Push utility carts up to 60 pounds
  3. Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  4. Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  5. Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  6. Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)
  7. Adhere to strict safety, quality, and fulfillment production standards

What it's like at an Amazon Fulfillment Center
  1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide protective gear. All teams share safety tips daily.
  2. Surroundings. You’ll be working around moving machines – order pickers, stand-up forklifts, turret trucks, and mobile carts.
  3. Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
  4. Temperature. Even with climate controls, temperatures can vary between 60°F and 90°F in some parts of the warehouse; on hot days, temperatures can be over 90°F in the truck yard or inside trailers.
  5. Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  6. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes are required. Depending on the role or location, Amazon provides a $110 Zappos gift code towards the purchase of shoes, in order to have you prepared for your first day on the job.

Why You’ll Love this Job
  1. Stay busy. You and your team are engaged the entire shift.
  2. Schedule options. Depending on where you work, schedules may include full-time (40 hours), reduced-time (30-36 hours) or part-time (20 hours or less), all with the option of working additional hours if needed.
  3. Shift flexibility. Work when it works for you. Shifts may include overnight, early morning, day, evening, and weekend. You can even have four-day workweeks, three-day weekends – and with Anytime Shifts, you can work as little as four hours per week.
  4. Career advancement. We have made a pledge to upskill our employees and offer a variety of free training and development programs, and we also have tuition support options for select employee groups. See where your Amazon journey can take you.
  5. New skills. Depending on the role and location, you’ll learn: how to operate a garment press and high-capacity printer, a t-shirt folding machine, how to assist with the print production process, or how to receive and process customer returns.
  6. Free training. Depending on the role and location, we’ll teach you how to drive power industrial trucks (PIT) such as forklifts or a pallet driver, how the printing process works, and how to work with the latest Amazon technology – including robots.
  7. Team environment. Work on small or large teams that support each other.

Why You'll Love Amazon
Many of our jobs come with great benefits – including healthcare, parental leave, ways to save for the future, and opportunities for career advancement – all in a safe and inclusive environment that’s been ranked among the best workplaces in the world. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location, and can include the following:
  1. Competitive wage paid weekly, with overtime for more than 40 hours
  2. Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  3. Medical Advice Line
  4. Network of Support (health & well-being on and off the job)
  5. Adoption Assistance
  6. Maternity and Parental Leave
  7. 401(k) savings plan
  8. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  9. Holiday pay opportunities
  10. Employee discounts
  11. Basic life insurance
  12. AD&D insurance
  13. Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  14. On-the-job training and skills development
  15. Employee Assistance Program

Learn more about Amazon Benefits and Culture
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits#/
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/culture#/

Requirements:
  1. Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.

If you have a disability and need an accommodation during the application and hiring process, including support for the New Hire Event, or need to initiate a request prior to starting your Day 1, please visit https://hiring.amazon.com/people-with-disabilities#/ or contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT). You can reach us by phone at 888-435-9287, Monday through Friday, between 6 a.m. and 4 p.m. PT.

Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

job.title: Commercial Building Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Job Summary:
In this role you’ll be face-to-face ambassador of the company dealing directly with our clients.

You’ll assist the property supervisor in maintaining the physical aspects of the Indiana buildings by performing light repair and maintenance duties for both common areas of buildings and within tenant spaces; inspecting, investigating, or assessing conditions to be performed by third party vendors; inspecting, investing or assessing conditions after all work has been completed by such vendors.

This role requires a hands-on, highly skilled technician who can independently diagnose, repair, and maintain building systems while serving as the Owner Representative holding vendors accountable to Meritex standards, alongside the Senior Property Manager.
 The ideal candidate has deep experience in commercial or industrial facilities, strong troubleshooting skills across multiple trades, and the professionalism to interact with tenants, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
 

Responsibilities:

  • Support basic requests by tenants for repair, maintenance and projects, utilize vendors
  • Perform maintenance tasks as directed by supervisor.
  • Maintain good tenant relations – complete or escalate support for repairs as needed
  • Partner with vendors and contractors to check in to see if projects are on track.
  • Regularly inspect HVAC, fire/life safety equipment, document results and notify supervisor and vendor of any issues.
  • Keep supervisor informed as to status of work orders and work assignments.
  • Ensure all properties are free of trash and debris.
  • Replace lights and ceiling tiles and paint when needed.
  • Communicate all building and tenant issues to supervisor.
  • Be knowledgeable and continuously promote safe work practices. Complete all required training including OSHA trainings.
  • Other duties as assigned.
 

Education/Skills/Experience/Qualities:

  • 5+ years of hands-on maintenance experience in an industrial commercial setting
  • Knowledge of fire systems, managing vendors, bidding projects, HVAC
  • High school diploma or equivalent (requires some technical college or applicable certifications).
  • Dependability and a valid Indiana driver’s license, good driving record, ability to travel to multiple properties and comply with company policies with vehicle usage are required.
  • Ability to multitask, remain flexible and professional.
  • Maintain a positive team attitude and provide excellent customer service.
  • Mechanical aptitude, ability to read schematics/engineering
  • Requires walking and driving to properties, bending, twisting, lifting up to 20 lbs., and climbing fixed ladders to access roofs and extension ladders
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.

Now hiring a Standup Forklift Operator in Savannah, GA, with shift flexibility and a competitive pay rate up to $18.00 per hour. This role is essential to supporting our high-volume distribution center operations, with opportunities for growth and development.


Benefits

  • Medical and dental coverage
  • Free online education programs
  • Financial tools and community resources
  • Career advancement opportunities
  • Collaborative, safety-focused work environment


About the Role
In this position, you will operate stand-up forklifts to efficiently retrieve, transport, and stage products throughout the warehouse. You will utilize RF scanners and Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) to accurately select, verify, and assemble customer orders. Your responsibilities include preparing pallets for outbound shipping, replenishing inventory, loading and unloading products, conducting daily equipment inspections, and maintaining a clean, organized workspace. Safety, accuracy, and attention to detail are key as you support seamless warehouse operations and ensure compliance with OSHA standards.


Pay Rate:
$17-18.00 per hour


Available Shift Times
First Shift Available.


Key Responsibilities

  • Operate stand-up forklifts efficiently for product retrieval and staging
  • Use RF scanners and WMS to ensure order accuracy
  • Prepare pallets for outbound shipping with wrapping, labeling, and staging
  • Replenish inventory at pick locations to sustain workflow
  • Load and unload products while adhering to shipping specifications
  • Perform daily safety and equipment inspections and report issues
  • Maintain a clean and organized work environment
  • Support inventory accuracy through diligent product handling


Key Requirements

  • Proven experience operating stand-up forklifts in a warehouse setting
  • Proficiency with RF scanners and WMS software
  • Strong attention to detail and safety compliance
  • Ability to meet productivity goals
  • Knowledge of OSHA safety standards
  • Effective time management and organization skills
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced team environment

  • Safe and clean work environment

  • Support warehouse operations through material handling and general labor duties
  • Maintain a clean and safe work environment following OSHA guidelines

job.title: Lumper / Freight Unloader
job.description:
Now hiring a Lumper / Freight Unloader in Savannah, GA, first shift available and a starting pay rate of $15.00 per hour. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced warehouse environment, performing high-volume freight unloading and palletizing operations with potential earnings exceeding $20-$25 per hour for top performers.


Benefits

  • Competitive pay with performance incentives
  • Opportunities for advancement
  • Safe, clean, and organized work environment
  • Comprehensive safety training in compliance with OSHA regulations
  • Access to online education programs and financial planning tools


About the Role
As a Lumper / Freight Unloader, you'll be responsible for efficiently unloading freight, sorting products, building pallets, and preparing shipments for warehouse distribution. You will work collaboratively with team members to meet productivity goals while maintaining safety and accuracy in a high-volume setting.


Pay Rate:
$15.00 per hour, with top performers earning more based on productivity and accuracy.


Available Shift Times:
First Shift Available


Key Responsibilities

  • Unload trailers containing diverse products efficiently and safely.
  • Sort, organize, and palletize freight according to specifications.
  • Utilize pallet jacks and material handling equipment correctly.
  • Verify freight quantities and identify damaged or misplaced items.
  • Maintain safety protocols and a clean work environment.
  • Assist with trailer cleanout, staging, and warehouse housekeeping.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure timely processing of shipments.


Key Requirements

  • Ability to perform heavy lifting and stand for extended periods.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Prior experience with freight unloading, pallet building, or warehouse operations preferred.
  • Knowledge of OSHA safety standards.
  • Good teamwork, time management, and communication skills.

job.title: Amazon Fulfillment Center Warehouse Associate
job.description:
Amazon Fulfillment Center Warehouse Associate

Shifts:
Day, Overnight, Weekend

Location:
Chester, VA
Job opportunities vary by location. We update postings daily with open positions.

Hourly pay rate: Up to $20.50

Job Overview
You’ll be part of the Amazon warehouse team that gets orders ready for customers relying on Amazon services. Our fast-paced, physical roles take place in a variety of areas including merch, make-on-demand, customer returns, Prime Now, and general fulfillment. You will be selecting, packing, and shipping orders – in some cases, for our super-fast (2-hour or less) delivery service.

Duties & Responsibilities
Some of your duties may include:
  1. Receive and put away inventory
  2. Get customer orders ready and pack them up
  3. Load boxes into trucks for shipment
  4. Use scanners to read bar codes on products
  5. View prompts on screens and follow the direction for some tasks
  6. Troubleshoot problems
  7. Ensure product meets quality requirements
  8. Operate power industrial trucks (PIT) such as a forklift or pallet driver, and work at heights up to 35 feet. Equipment training and certification are provided free of cost.
You'll also need to be able to:
  1. Lift up to 49 pounds
  2. Push utility carts up to 60 pounds
  3. Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  4. Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  5. Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  6. Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)
  7. Adhere to strict safety, quality, and fulfillment production standards

What it's like at an Amazon Fulfillment Center
  1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide protective gear. All teams share safety tips daily.
  2. Surroundings. You’ll be working around moving machines – order pickers, stand-up forklifts, turret trucks, and mobile carts.
  3. Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
  4. Temperature. Even with climate controls, temperatures can vary between 60°F and 90°F in some parts of the warehouse; on hot days, temperatures can be over 90°F in the truck yard or inside trailers.
  5. Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  6. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes are required. Depending on the role or location, Amazon provides a $110 Zappos gift code towards the purchase of shoes, in order to have you prepared for your first day on the job.

Why You’ll Love this Job
  1. Stay busy. You and your team are engaged the entire shift.
  2. Schedule options. Depending on where you work, schedules may include full-time (40 hours), reduced-time (30-36 hours) or part-time (20 hours or less), all with the option of working additional hours if needed.
  3. Shift flexibility. Work when it works for you. Shifts may include overnight, early morning, day, evening, and weekend. You can even have four-day workweeks, three-day weekends – and with Anytime Shifts, you can work as little as four hours per week.
  4. Career advancement. We have made a pledge to upskill our employees and offer a variety of free training and development programs, and we also have tuition support options for select employee groups. See where your Amazon journey can take you.
  5. New skills. Depending on the role and location, you’ll learn: how to operate a garment press and high-capacity printer, a t-shirt folding machine, how to assist with the print production process, or how to receive and process customer returns.
  6. Free training. Depending on the role and location, we’ll teach you how to drive power industrial trucks (PIT) such as forklifts or a pallet driver, how the printing process works, and how to work with the latest Amazon technology – including robots.
  7. Team environment. Work on small or large teams that support each other.

Why You'll Love Amazon
Many of our jobs come with great benefits – including healthcare, parental leave, ways to save for the future, and opportunities for career advancement – all in a safe and inclusive environment that’s been ranked among the best workplaces in the world. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location, and can include the following:
  1. Competitive wage paid weekly, with overtime for more than 40 hours
  2. Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  3. Medical Advice Line
  4. Network of Support (health & well-being on and off the job)
  5. Adoption Assistance
  6. Maternity and Parental Leave
  7. 401(k) savings plan
  8. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  9. Holiday pay opportunities
  10. Employee discounts
  11. Basic life insurance
  12. AD&D insurance
  13. Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  14. On-the-job training and skills development
  15. Employee Assistance Program
Learn more about Amazon Benefits and Culture
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits#/
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/culture#/

Requirements:
  1. Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.

How To Get Started
You can begin by applying above. If you need help with your application or to learn more about our hiring process, you can find support here: https://hiring.amazon.com/hiring-process#/.

If you have a disability and need an accommodation during the application and hiring process, including support for the New Hire Event, or need to initiate a request prior to starting your Day 1, please visit https://hiring.amazon.com/people-with-disabilities#/ or contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT). You can reach us by phone at 888-435-9287, Monday through Friday, between 6 a.m. and 4 p.m. PT.

Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

job.description:

Ubicación: Phillipsburg, NJ
Duración: Asignación a largo plazo
¡¡Nosotros hablamos español!!

Buscamos un Asociado de Almacén motivado y confiable para unirse a nuestro equipo. Turno: Los turnos varían los 7 días de la semana

Horario de los turnos: varios horarios
Hay disponibilidad de horas extras

Tarifa salarial: $16.00 - $17.50 por hora

Beneficios y ventajas:

  • Pago semanal
  • Beneficios desde el primer día: ¡médicos, dentales y de la vista, incluida la telemedicina!
  • Visitas ilimitadas de telemedicina y atención de urgencia para usted y su familia
  • Seguro de vida temporal colectivo para el empleado, su cónyuge e hijos
  • Cobertura por discapacidad a corto plazo
  • Programa de tarjeta de descuentos en medicamentos recetados para quienes estén inscritos en los beneficios médicos

  • Posibilidad de unirse a nuestro programa 401(k)


Deberes y responsabilidades esenciales:

  • Cargar y descargar envíos
  • Verificar, documentar e informar sobre cualquier daño o discrepancia en comparación con el manifiesto de carga
  • Confirmar todos los documentos de la carga
  • Generar un informe de daños ante cualquier desperfecto
  • Recibir, contar y clasificar envíos
  • Preparar y paletizar envíos
  • Medir y pesar envíos

  • Asegurarse de que se observen y cumplan todas las normas de carga, seguridad y protección

  • Informar de inmediato a la gerencia sobre fallas en el servicio o problemas que deban abordarse directamente con el cliente
  • Otras tareas asignadas por el supervisor (Lead) o gerente, según las necesidades del departamento, su desempeño y sus capacidades
  • Disposición para trabajar en un horario de turnos rotativos de 8 a 10 horas, si fuera necesario


Requisitos:

  • Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y como parte de un equipo
  • Capacidad para seguir instrucciones y trabajar de manera segura

job.title: Amazon Warehouse Equipment Operator
job.description:
Amazon Warehouse Equipment Operator

Shifts:
Day, Overnight, Weekend

Location:
Lebanon, TN
Job opportunities vary by location. We update postings daily with open positions.

Hourly pay rate: Up to $20.75


Job Overview:
You'll be part of the Amazon warehouse team as an equipment operator - operating order pickers, reach trucks, forklifts, and other powered industrial trucks (PIT) to handle customer orders safely and efficiently. You'll use PIT equipment to unload and load trailers, store pallets, and retrieve pallets throughout the warehouse. No prior experience required—Amazon provides all PIT training and certification for free.

Duties & Responsibilities
Some of your duties may include:
  1. Receive and put away inventory
  2. Get customer orders ready and pack them up
  3. Load boxes into trucks for shipment
  4. Use scanners to read bar codes on products
  5. View prompts on screens and follow the direction for some tasks
  6. Troubleshoot problems
  7. Ensure product meets quality requirements
  8. Operate power industrial trucks (PIT) such as a forklift or pallet driver, and work at heights up to 35 feet. Equipment training and certification are provided free of cost.
You'll also need to be able to:
  1. Lift up to 49 pounds
  2. Push utility carts up to 60 pounds
  3. Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  4. Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  5. Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  6. Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)
  7. Adhere to strict safety, quality, and fulfillment production standards

What it's like at an Amazon Fulfillment Center
  1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide protective gear. All teams share safety tips daily.
  2. Surroundings. You’ll be working around moving machines – order pickers, stand-up forklifts, turret trucks, and mobile carts.
  3. Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
  4. Temperature. Even with climate controls, temperatures can vary between 60°F and 90°F in some parts of the warehouse; on hot days, temperatures can be over 90°F in the truck yard or inside trailers.
  5. Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  6. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes are required. Depending on the role or location, Amazon provides a $110 Zappos gift code towards the purchase of shoes, in order to have you prepared for your first day on the job.

Why You’ll Love this Job
  1. Stay busy. You and your team are engaged the entire shift.
  2. Schedule options. Depending on where you work, schedules may include full-time (40 hours), reduced-time (30-36 hours) or part-time (20 hours or less), all with the option of working additional hours if needed.
  3. Shift flexibility. Work when it works for you. Shifts may include overnight, early morning, day, evening, and weekend. You can even have four-day workweeks, three-day weekends – and with Anytime Shifts, you can work as little as four hours per week.
  4. Career advancement. We have made a pledge to upskill our employees and offer a variety of free training and development programs, and we also have tuition support options for select employee groups. See where your Amazon journey can take you.
  5. New skills. Depending on the role and location, you’ll learn: how to operate a garment press and high-capacity printer, a t-shirt folding machine, how to assist with the print production process, or how to receive and process customer returns.
  6. Free training. Depending on the role and location, we’ll teach you how to drive power industrial trucks (PIT) such as forklifts or a pallet driver, how the printing process works, and how to work with the latest Amazon technology – including robots.
  7. Team environment. Work on small or large teams that support each other.

Why You'll Love Amazon
Many of our jobs come with great benefits – including healthcare, parental leave, ways to save for the future, and opportunities for career advancement – all in a safe and inclusive environment that’s been ranked among the best workplaces in the world. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location, and can include the following:
  1. Competitive wage paid weekly, with overtime for more than 40 hours
  2. Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  3. Medical Advice Line
  4. Network of Support (health & well-being on and off the job)
  5. Adoption Assistance
  6. Maternity and Parental Leave
  7. 401(k) savings plan
  8. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  9. Holiday pay opportunities
  10. Employee discounts
  11. Basic life insurance
  12. AD&D insurance
  13. Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  14. On-the-job training and skills development
  15. Employee Assistance Program

Learn more about Amazon Benefits and Culture
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits#/
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/culture#/
Requirements:
  1. Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.

How To Get Started
You can begin by applying above. If you need help with your application or to learn more about our hiring process, you can find support here: https://hiring.amazon.com/hiring-process#/.

If you have a disability and need an accommodation during the application and hiring process, including support for the New Hire Event, or need to initiate a request prior to starting your Day 1, please visit https://hiring.amazon.com/people-with-disabilities#/ or contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT). You can reach us by phone at 888-435-9287, Monday through Friday, between 6 a.m. and 4 p.m. PT.

Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.
